audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Fiora while whys[0] says both are weak and to 'trade nothing'; First item read Poppy while whys[5] describes trading back to even. The header also called a FAV lane 'Tricky' in the final rating line.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Poppy/Fiora/Skill/Poppy, and the mirror audit has already set win[0]=Skill and win[5]=Skill with matching side flips — matching those two rows keeps both directions identical.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 5 flipped to Skill in both layers with ratings adjusted, and the rating line brought in line with the FAV verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire page tells you to play around Riposte without ever saying how long it is down for.
audit.why: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and 16s maxed — the longest window in the lane and the reason baiting it is worth a whole trade. Lunge is 13s at rank 1 dropping to 6s, and Grand Challenge is 110/90/70.
audit.corrected: 24s, 13s and 110s written into dosFull[0], the cooldown block, report[5] and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: The parry interaction was stated but not its trigger condition, and neither Duelist's Dance's healing nor Lunge's on-hit application appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text: Riposte parries all incoming damage and disables, then stabs — and it stuns only if it blocked an immobilizing effect. That is exactly what your E wall-stun and Keeper's Verdict's knockup are, which is why opening with a committal cast is the losing line. The passive heals her and grants move speed on every Vital hit, and Lunge applies on-hit effects, so her damage reads worse than pure armour maths suggest.
audit.corrected: The blocked-CC condition spelled out, the Vital heal named as the anti-heal target, and Lunge's on-hit noted in the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The item line's anti-heal note is generic and the don't about stacking HP had filler text.
audit.why: Her sustain is Duelist's Dance on every Vital plus the Grand Challenge heal — Grievous Wounds timing is the whole extended duel.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2] and the late-game text now tie anti-heal to Vitals specifically.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Fiora carry threat 10/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Fiora carry threat 10/10.

edits.before: Parries + stuns. Bait it before E. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 — bait it out, because it stuns you if it eats CC.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Riposte parries your R too — a blocked knockup stuns you back.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Duelist's Dance heals her off every Vital she hits, so get Grievous Wounds down early.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries + stuns. Bait it before E. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riposte: 24s at rank 1, 16s maxed — it parries your E or R and stuns you back if it blocks the CC. - Lunge: 13s at rank 1, 6s maxed, and it applies on-hit. - Grand Challenge: 110s, and it heals her.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries + stuns. Bait it before E. When it is down — E-Q + R her.
edits.after: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and stuns you if it parries your E or R — bait it before you commit.

edits.before: Fiora owns 6 — her W parries your E or R and stuns you back, flipping the all-in and letting her stack vitals.
edits.after: Fiora owns 6 — Riposte parries your E or R, and because it blocked CC it stuns you back, flipping the all-in.

edits.before: Fiora's danger window: her W parries your E or R cast and stuns you, flipping the all-in and letting her vital-stack you down.
edits.after: Her window: Riposte parries your E or R, and blocking that CC upgrades its stab to a stun — then Grand Challenge heals her through it.

edits.before: Fiora's whole early plan is to dash in with Q, tag a vital, and dash back out before you can grab her — so deny her the free vital uptime. At level 2-3 your power spike is real: hold W to ground her Q dash, then E her into the nearest wall for the stun and Q the max-HP chunk while she's locked. Don't waste E in the open where she just gets pushed and walks off; only commit it when there's a wall behind her. Respect that she can parry, so don't telegraph the E.
edits.after: Fiora's early plan is Lunge in on 13s, tag a Vital for the heal, and step back out before you can grab her — deny that free Vital uptime. At level 2-3 your spike is real: hold W for her Lunge, then E her into the nearest wall for the stun and Q her while she's locked. Only commit E with a wall behind her. Riposte is 24s at rank 1 — bait it first, because a parried stun turns into a stun on you.

edits.before: Parry your E or R with W to cancel the stun and stun you back
edits.after: Parry your E or R — blocking that CC turns her stab into a stun

edits.before: Long-term this is a true coinflip, and the 52% edge is real but thin. Your kit value is gold-independent — W dash-deny and E-wall stun never fall off — so you stay relevant where a normal tank wouldn't. But a fed Fiora out-duels you at items if she parries your key cast, so never fight her in open ground or at her sidelane tower. Group, peel for your carries with W and R displacement, and make her duel into your wall, not the other way around.
edits.after: Long-term this is a true coinflip, and the 52% edge is real but thin. Your kit value is gold-independent — W dash-deny and E-wall stun never fall off — so you stay relevant where a normal tank wouldn't. But she heals off every Vital and again off Grand Challenge, so anti-heal is not optional, and a banked 16s Riposte beats your key cast. Group, peel with W and R, and make her duel into your wall.

notes: Riposte's stun is conditional and that condition is the whole matchup: it stuns only if it parried an immobilizing effect, which is exactly what your E wall-stun and Keeper's Verdict's knockup are. Rows 0 and 5 flipped to Skill in both layers to match the mirror's already-proposed chart.
